djIntro: Mix temperature (GISTEMP), rain (NASA POWER) and sea ice (NOAA/NSIDC G02135, 2023) of the selected point over a shared pulse. Requires enabling sound above.
compositionExplain: Listen to a {seconds} s piece (8 bars at 96 BPM) with three synthesized instruments: soft piano (temperature), drops (rain) and a crystalline pad (ice). It is not a real acoustic piano. It never starts by itself.
compositionRules: Rules: temperature raises or lowers the register of the same motif (C-D-E-G-A); rain adds drops on the pulse without changing the tempo; ice gives one soft chord per bar with volume equal to its fraction. No data means that instrument is silent; ice 0 is silence and rain 0 is zero drops.
compositionStatusPlaying: Playing the {seconds} s composition. New data enters at the next bar; a null value silences that instrument immediately.
soundingNothing: No instrument is sounding: there is no real data for this point and period.
soundingIceZero: Ice: real 0% (silence, below the detection threshold).
musicRangeNote: Fixed musical range from {min} to +{max} °C (music version 2), the same for every point and period; it differs from the legend color range (-5 to +5 °C). The scale has 16 registers: close values may sound the same, the real value is shown above.
musicSaturated: The {value} °C anomaly exceeds the musical range: the sound saturates at the extreme, but the displayed value is the real one.
shareErrorMusicVersion: The link uses an unknown music version ({version}); it is not played so as not to claim it sounds the same.
shareLegacyMusic: Note: this link comes from the previous music version (linear -5 to +5 scale). The current music uses a different mapping and may sound different; the data are the same.
djNoPoint: Select a point on the globe or in Accessible to mix its data.
djRainLoading: Loading NASA POWER rain for this point...
djRainApi: Rain: live NASA POWER query (MERRA-2), year {year}.
djRainError: Could not get rain data for this point (network/CORS). Only locally available points are used.
djRainSaturated: Rain value outside the 0-20 mm/day musical range: visually saturated.
djUnitsNote: PRECTOTCORR = monthly average of the daily rate (mm/day), MERRA-2 reanalysis, NOT a monthly total.
djDataVersionMismatch: Note: this data arrived with a different version than the opened shared link; it may have changed since then.
djIceLoading: Loading NOAA/NSIDC sea ice for this point...
djIceError: Could not get sea ice data for this point (network/validation).
djIceOutOfSeries: Period {period}: outside the real available series (2023 only); not extrapolated, no data.
djIceValue: Period {period}: {percent}% ice concentration (fraction of valid ocean area).
djIceValueMissing: Period {period}: no data (land, coast, pole-hole, or no valid ocean coverage in this cell).
djIceCoverage: Coverage: {count} real 25 km pixels averaged into this 2° cell.
djIceSource: Source: NOAA/NSIDC G02135 "Sea Ice Index" v4.0, 2023 data derived from NSIDC-0051 (NASA Team algorithm, through Dec. 2024; NSIDC-0803, also NASA Team, from Jan. 2025); not a pure NASA dataset.
djIceThresholdNote: G02135 sets pixel values below the 15% detection threshold to 0: a 0 (or a low aggregate) does not prove ice is absolutely absent.
djIceExploreTitle: Explore hemispheres (real points with verified coverage)

historyIntro: Choose a place and the month and year you were born. We compare that month's temperature anomaly with the latest real month available, and you can listen to both, one after the other.
historyPlaceHelp: Search for a city with at least 2 letters. Search stays local. If it is missing, pick a point on the globe or use coordinates in Accessible.
historyUseGlobe: Use my point on the globe
historyBirthNote: Monthly data from {min}. No day is needed.

historySearchCount: {total} results; showing the {shown} largest. Refine your search if yours is not listed.
historyPlaceNone: Choose a city or a point on the globe.
historyErrNoPlace: Choose a place: search for a city or use the globe point.
historyErrEmpty: Enter the month and year you were born.
historyErrInvalid: The year must have 4 digits and the month must be valid.
historyErrBefore: The data starts in {min}. Choose a date from then on.

historyNoDataListen: This epoch has no data; there is no music for it.
historySpeechUnsupported: Your browser has no speech voice; the text above is the full story.
historyAnnounceNoData: {period}: no data in this cell; there is no music for this month.
historyVoiceLabel: Announce each epoch by voice (optional; the text is always shown)
historySpeak: Listen to the story with voice
historyLearnTitle: How to interpret what you hear
historyHowTo: Each month plays as a short 20-second piece with the same motif, tempo, volume and seed. Only the anomaly changes: the higher it is, the higher the notes sound.
historyVariability: A single month changes a lot from year to year; only many years together show a long-term trend. This comparison does not show a trend or a cause.
historyQuestion1: Guiding question: what changed in the notes between before and after?
historyQuestion2: Guiding question: what data is missing to draw a conclusion?
historyMissing: Not shown: the exact weather of a day, absolute temperature, other months and years at the same place, or causes. Try another month or another place.
historyPrivacy: Saved only when you select “Save and generate link”. The link contains coordinates and months, without a name or exact day.
historyDetailsSummary: See the data and how to read it
historyShortNote: Monthly anomalies for a broad region. Two months alone do not establish a trend.

djCaptionIce: Soft chord: its volume is the ice fraction.
